datasets.name: AC-CCM
datasets.description: AC-CCM 是首个专注于中国民乐意境识别的数据集，基于清代琴学经典《溪山琴况》的二十四况理论框架，涵盖多种乐器、时代与风格。
datasets.descriptionEn: AC-CCM is the first dataset focused on aesthetic mood recognition in Chinese traditional music. Based on the Twenty-Four Conditions framework in the Qing-dynasty qin treatise Xishan Qinkuang, it covers multiple instruments, periods, and styles.

datasets.name: GZVarMSA
datasets.description: GZVarMSA 是用于音乐结构分析的中国古筝变奏曲数据集，包含 80 首传统筝曲、18,081 秒音频，覆盖潮州、山东、陕西、浙江四大筝乐流派，并提供结构复杂度人工标注。
datasets.descriptionEn: GZVarMSA is a Chinese guzheng variation dataset for music structure analysis. It contains 80 traditional zheng pieces and 18,081 seconds of audio, covering the Chaozhou, Shandong, Shaanxi, and Zhejiang schools, with manual annotations of structural complexity.

datasets.name: XFID
datasets.description: XFID 是用于自动音乐转录的新疆民族乐器数据集，覆盖都塔尔、萨塔尔、弹拨尔三种代表性乐器，包含约 4 小时无损录音、对齐 MIDI 标注和可读乐谱。
datasets.descriptionEn: XFID is a Xinjiang folk instrument dataset for automatic music transcription. It covers dutar, satar, and tanbur, and contains approximately four hours of lossless recordings, aligned MIDI annotations, and readable scores.

datasets.name: Live Music Denoising
datasets.description: 面向真实现场音乐降噪的数据集，包含 146 个音乐源录音、1,078 个干净音乐片段，约 626 分钟。公开源链接、片段时间戳及 Normal、Strong、Extreme 三档基准噪声生成元数据。
datasets.descriptionEn: A dataset for authentic live music denoising, containing 146 music source recordings and 1,078 clean music excerpts, approximately 626 minutes in total. It releases source URLs, excerpt timestamps, and benchmark noise generation metadata for Normal, Strong, and Extreme conditions.
